import os

from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any
from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel

# --- Adatbázis Modellek (SingleStore) ---
Base = declarative_base()

class ResearchSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "research_sources"
    id = Column(String, primary_key=True)
    session_id = Column(String, index=True)
    url = Column(String)
    title = Column(String)

    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

# --- Adatbázis Kezelők ---
class DatabaseManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.engine = create_engine(Config.SINGLESTORE_CONNECTION, pool_pre_ping=True)
        self.SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=self.engine)
        Base.metadata.create_all(self.engine)
        self.redis_client = redis.from_url(Config.DRAGONFLY_URL, decode_responses=True)

    def get_session(self):
        return self.SessionLocal()

# Globális DB Manager instance
db_manager = DatabaseManager()

# --- API Kliensek ---

class CerebrasClient:
    async def decompose_query(self, query: str, complexity: str) -> List[str]:
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {Config.CEREBRAS_API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        max_tokens = 2000 if complexity == "standard" else 5000
        
        payload = {

            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "Te egy kutatási router. Bonts szét a lekérdezést optimalizált alkérdésekre a mélykutatáshoz."},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Kérdés: {query}. Komplexitás: {complexity}. Adj vissza 5-20 részletkérdést JSON listaként."}
            ],
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "temperature": 0.7
        }
        
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            async with session.post(Config.CEREBRAS_URL, headers=headers, json=payload) as resp:
                data = await resp.json()
                # Egyszerűsített parsing a példa kedvéért
                content = data['choices'][0]['message']['content']
                # Itt lenne a JSON parse logika
                return [f"{query} részlet {i+1}" for i in range(10)] # Placeholder

class GLMClient:
    async def synthesize_report(self, sources: List[Dict], query: str, max_tokens: int = 128000) -> str:
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {Config.GLM_API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        # Kontextus építése (limitált a példa kedvéért)
        context_text = "\n".join([f"Forrás: {s['title']}\n{str(s['content'])[:500]}" for s in sources[:50]])
        
        payload = {
            "model": "glm-4.7",
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "Te egy fő kutató. Szintetizálj átfogó jelentést a megadott források alapján."},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Kutatási kérdés: {query}\n\nForrások:\n{context_text}"}
            ],
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "temperature": 0.3
        }
        
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            async with session.post(Config.GLM_URL, headers=headers, json=payload) as resp:
                data = await resp.json()
                return data['choices'][0]['message']['content']

class ClaudeClient:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=Config.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

    async def validate_quality(self, report: str, query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # Szinkron hívás asyncio loopban
        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
        
        def _sync_call():
            message = self.client.messages.create(
                model="claude-4-5-opus-20250128",
                max_tokens=4096,
                betas=["effort-2025-11-24"],
                system="Értékeld a kutatási jelentés minőségét (0.0 - 1.0). Vissza egy JSON objektumot score és weak_fields mezőkkel.",
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Kérdés: {query}\n\nJelentés: {report[:10000]}"}] # Trim a context limit miatt
            )
            return message.content[0].text
        
        response_text = await loop.run_in_executor(None, _sync_call)
        
        try:
            data = json.loads(response_text)
            return {"score": float(data.get("score", 0.7)), "feedback": data.get("weak_fields", [])}
        except:
            return {"score": 0.8, "feedback": []}

class SearchAggregator:
    async def parallel_search(self, queries: List[str], mode: str):
        tasks = []
        
        # Exa AI
        async def exa_search(q):
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
                headers = {"x-api-key": Config.EXA_API_KEY}
                payload = {"query": q, "numResults": 100, "type": "neural", "contents": {"text": True}}
                async with session.post("https://api.exa.ai/search", headers=headers, json=payload) as resp:
                    return await resp.json()
        
        # Parallel API (Ultra8x)
        async def parallel_search_ultra(q):
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
                headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {Config.PARALLEL_API_KEY}"}
                payload = {"query": q, "processor": "ultra8x", "maxSources": 25000}
                async with session.post("https://api.parallel.dolores/search", headers=headers, json=payload) as resp:
                    return await resp.json()

        if mode == "ultra_deep":
            tasks.append(parallel_search_ultra(queries[0]))
        
        for q in queries[:5]: # Exa limit
            tasks.append(exa_search(q))
            
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        # Eredmények aggregálása
        aggregated = []
        for res in results:
            if isinstance(res, dict) and "results" in res:
                aggregated.extend(res["results"])
        return aggregated

# --- Pydantic Modellek ---
class ResearchRequest(BaseModel):
    query: str
    mode: str = "standard"  # 'standard' vagy 'ultra_deep'

# --- Fő Munkafolyamat ---

async def execute_research_workflow(session_id: str, request: ResearchRequest):
    # 1. Állapot frissítése: Kezdet
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "query_decomposition")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "5")
    
    cerebras = CerebrasClient()
    
    # 2. Query dekompozíció
    queries = await cerebras.decompose_query(request.query, request.mode)
    
    # 3. Párhuzamos keresés
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "searching")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "15")
    
    aggregator = SearchAggregator()
    sources = await aggregator.parallel_search(queries, request.mode)
    
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "total_sources", len(sources))
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "processing_sources")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "40")
    
    # 4. Mentés SingleStore-ba
    db_session = db_manager.get_session()
    try:
        for src in sources[:5000]: # Limit a példa kedvéért
            db_source = ResearchSource(
                id=f"{session_id}_{src.get('id', str(hash(src.get('title', ''))))}",
                session_id=session_id,
                url=src.get('url', ''),
                title=src.get('title', ''),
                content=src.get('text', ''),
                relevance_score=src.get('score', 0.5)
            )
            db_session.add(db_source)
        db_session.commit()
    finally:
        db_session.close()
        
    # 5. Szintézis (GLM 4.7)
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "synthesis")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "60")
    
    glm = GLMClient()
    report = await glm.synthesize_report(sources, request.query)
    
    # 6. Validáció (Claude)
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "validation")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "90")
    
    claude = ClaudeClient()
    validation = await claude.validate_quality(report, request.query)
    
    # 7. Mentés és lezárás
    final_report = {
        "content": report,
        "validation_score": validation["score"],
        "sources_count": len(sources),
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
    }
    
    db_manager.redis_client.set(f"report:{session_id}", json.dumps(final_report))
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "completed")
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "100")
    
    # Supermemory mentés (szimuláció)
    # await supermemory_add_memory(session_id, request.query, report)

# --- API Végpontok ---

@app.post("/research")
async def start_research(request: ResearchRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    session_id = f"sess_{int(time.time())}_{hash(request.query)}"
    
    # Init session Redis-ben
    db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", mapping={
        "query": request.query,
        "mode": request.mode,
        "status": "queued",
        "progress": "0"
    })
    
    # Indítás háttérben
    background_tasks.add_task(execute_research_workflow, session_id, request)
    
    return {"session_id": session_id, "status": "processing"}

@app.get("/research/{session_id}/stream")
async def stream_research(session_id: str):
    async def event_generator():
        while True:
            data = db_manager.redis_client.hgetall(f"session:{session_id}")
            if not data:
                yield f"data: {json.dumps({'status': 'error', 'message': 'Session not found'})}\n\n"
                break
            
            status = data.get('status', 'unknown')
            progress = data.get('progress', '0')
            
            payload = {
                "status": status,
                "progress": float(progress),
                "data": data
            }
            
            yield f"data: {json.dumps(payload)}\n\n"
            
            if status == "completed" or status == "error":
                break
            
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            
    return StreamingResponse(event_generator(), media_type="text/event-stream")

@app.get("/research/{session_id}/report")
async def get_report(session_id: str):
    report_str = db_manager.redis_client.get(f"report:{session_id}")
    if not report_str:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="A jelentés még nem készült el")
    
    return json.loads(report_str)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

class ResearchResponse(BaseModel):

async def execute_research_workflow(session_id: str, request: ResearchRequest):
    try:
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "query_decomposition")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "5")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Lekérdezés elemzése")
        
        cerebras = CerebrasClient()
        decomposed = await cerebras.decompose_query(request.query, request.mode)
        queries = decomposed.get("queries", [request.query])
        
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "searching")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "20")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Források keresése")
        
        aggregator = SearchAggregator()
        sources = await aggregator.parallel_search(queries, request.mode)
        
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "total_sources", str(len(sources)))
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "processing_sources")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "45")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Források feldolgozása")
        
        db_session = db_manager.get_session()
        if db_session:
            try:
                for idx, src in enumerate(sources[:10000]):
                    source_id = f"{session_id}_{idx}_{hashlib.md5(str(src.get('url', idx)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
                    db_source = ResearchSource(
                        id=source_id,
                        session_id=session_id,
                        url=src.get('url', ''),
                        title=src.get('title', ''),
                        content=str(src.get('content', ''))[:50000],
                        relevance_score=float(src.get('score', 0.5)),
                        metadata={"source_api": src.get('source', 'unknown')}
                    )
                    db_session.add(db_source)
                db_session.commit()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Database insert error: {e}")
                db_session.rollback()
            finally:
                db_session.close()
        
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "synthesis")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "65")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Jelentés szintetizálása")
        
        glm = GLMClient()
        report = await glm.synthesize_report(sources, request.query)
        
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "validation")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "85")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Minőségellenőrzés")
        
        claude = ClaudeClient()
        validation = await claude.validate_quality(report, request.query)
        
        final_report = {
            "content": report,
            "validation_score": validation.get("score", 0.85),
            "sources_count": len(sources),
            "query": request.query,
            "mode": request.mode,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "weak_areas": validation.get("weak_areas", [])
        }
        
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.set(f"report:{session_id}", json.dumps(final_report, ensure_ascii=False))
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "completed")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "progress", "100")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", "Befejezve")
        
        logger.info(f"Research workflow completed for session {session_id}")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Research workflow error for session {session_id}: {e}")
        if db_manager.redis_client:
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "status", "error")
            await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", "current_stage", f"Hiba: {str(e)}")

@app.post("/research", response_model=ResearchResponse)
async def start_research(request: ResearchRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    session_id = f"sess_{int(time.time() * 1000)}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    
    if db_manager.redis_client:
        await db_manager.redis_client.hset(f"session:{session_id}", mapping={
            "query": request.query,
            "mode": request.mode,
            "status": "queued",
            "progress": "0",
            "current_stage": "Várakozás",
            "total_sources": "0"
        })
    
    background_tasks.add_task(execute_research_workflow, session_id, request)
    
    return ResearchResponse(session_id=session_id, status="processing")

@app.get("/research/{session_id}/stream")
async def stream_research(session_id: str):
    async def event_generator() -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
        for _ in range(300):
            if not db_manager.redis_client:
                yield f"data: {json.dumps({'status': 'error', 'message': 'Redis not available'})}\n\n"
                break
            
            try:
                data = await db_manager.redis_client.hgetall(f"session:{session_id}")
                if not data:
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps({'status': 'error', 'message': 'Session not found'})}\n\n"
                    break
                
                status = data.get('status', 'unknown')
                progress = float(data.get('progress', '0'))
                current_stage = data.get('current_stage', 'Feldolgozás')
                total_sources = int(data.get('total_sources', '0'))
                
                payload = {
                    "status": status,
                    "progress": progress,
                    "current_stage": current_stage,
                    "total_sources": total_sources
                }
                
                yield f"data: {json.dumps(payload)}\n\n"
                
                if status in ["completed", "error"]:
                    break
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Stream error: {e}")
                yield f"data: {json.dumps({'status': 'error', 'message': str(e)})}\n\n"
                break
            
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    return StreamingResponse(event_generator(), media_type="text/event-stream")

@app.get("/research/{session_id}/report")
async def get_report(session_id: str):
    if not db_manager.redis_client:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Redis nem elérhető")
    
    report_str = await db_manager.redis_client.get(f"report:{session_id}")
    if not report_str:
        session_data = await db_manager.redis_client.hgetall(f"session:{session_id}")
        if not session_data:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Munkamenet nem található")
        status = session_data.get('status', 'unknown')
        if status == 'completed':
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="A jelentés nem elérhető")
        else:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=202, detail=f"A jelentés még készül: {status}")
    
    try:
        report_data = json.loads(report_str)
        return JSONResponse(content=report_data)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Report parse error: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Hiba a jelentés betöltésekor")

@app.get("/health")
async def health_check():
    redis_status = "connected" if db_manager.redis_client else "disconnected"

    return {
        "status": "healthy",
        "redis": redis_status,
        "database": db_status,
        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
    }

                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="report-content" id="reportContent"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    let eventSource = null;
    let currentSessionId = null;

    async function startResearch() {
        const query = document.getElementById('queryInput').value.trim();
        const mode = document.getElementById('modeSelect').value;
        
        if (!query) {
            showAlert('Kérlek add meg a kutatási kérdést!', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const btn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Feldolgozás...';

        document.getElementById('progressContainer').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('resultsSection').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = '0%';
        document.getElementById('progressPercent').textContent = '0%';
        document.getElementById('statusMessage').textContent = 'Inicializálás...';
        document.getElementById('sourceCount').textContent = '0';
        document.getElementById('currentStage').textContent = 'Várakozás';

        try {
            const response = await fetch('/research', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ query: query, mode: mode })
            });

            if (!response.ok) {
                const errorData = await response.json();
                throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Hiba történt a kutatás indításakor');
            }

            const data = await response.json();
            currentSessionId = data.session_id;
            
            startStream(data.session_id);

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Research start error:', error);
            showAlert(error.message, 'error');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'Kutatás Indítása';
            document.getElementById('progressContainer').style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function startStream(sessionId) {
        if (eventSource) {
            eventSource.close();
        }

        eventSource = new EventSource(`/research/${sessionId}/stream`);

        eventSource.onmessage = function(event) {
            try {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                
                const percentage = Math.round(data.progress || 0);
                document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = `${percentage}%`;
                document.getElementById('progressPercent').textContent = `${percentage}%`;
                
                if (data.current_stage) {
                    document.getElementById('statusMessage').textContent = data.current_stage;
                    document.getElementById('currentStage').textContent = data.current_stage;
                }

                if (data.total_sources !== undefined) {
                    document.getElementById('sourceCount').textContent = data.total_sources.toLocaleString('hu-HU');
                }

                if (data.status === 'completed') {
                    eventSource.close();
                    fetchReport(sessionId);
                } else if (data.status === 'error') {
                    eventSource.close();
                    showAlert(data.message || 'Hiba történt a feldolgozás során', 'error');
                    document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled = false;
                    document.getElementById('startBtn').textContent = 'Újra Próbálom';
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Stream parse error:', e);
            }
        };

        eventSource.onerror = function(error) {
            console.error('EventSource error:', error);
            eventSource.close();
            showAlert('Kapcsolat megszakadt. Próbáld újra később.', 'error');
            document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled = false;
            document.getElementById('startBtn').textContent = 'Újra Próbálom';
        };
    }

    async function fetchReport(sessionId) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`/research/${sessionId}/report`);
            
            if (!response.ok) {
                const errorData = await response.json();
                throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Nem sikerült betölteni a jelentést');
            }
            
            const report = await response.json();
            
            document.getElementById('resultsSection').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('reportContent').textContent = report.content || 'Nincs tartalom';
            document.getElementById('reportSourceCount').textContent = (report.sources_count || 0).toLocaleString('hu-HU');
            
            const score = report.validation_score || 0;
            const scorePercent = Math.round(score * 100);
            document.getElementById('reportQualityScore').textContent = `${scorePercent}%`;
            
            const badge = document.getElementById('qualityBadge');
            badge.textContent = `Minőség: ${scorePercent}%`;
            badge.className = 'quality-badge ' + (score >= 0.85 ? 'quality-high' : score >= 0.7 ? 'quality-medium' : 'quality-low');
            
            if (report.timestamp) {
                const date = new Date(report.timestamp);
                document.getElementById('reportTimestamp').textContent = date.toLocaleString('hu-HU');
            }

            document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled = false;
            document.getElementById('startBtn').textContent = 'Új Kutatás';
            
            document.getElementById('resultsSection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Fetch report error:', error);
            showAlert(error.message, 'error');
            document.getElementById('startBtn').disabled = false;
            document.getElementById('startBtn').textContent = 'Újra Próbálom';
        }
    }

    function showAlert(message, type) {
        const alertDiv = document.createElement('div');
        alertDiv.className = `alert alert-${type}`;
        alertDiv.textContent = message;
        
        const container = document.querySelector('.container');
        container.insertBefore(alertDiv, container.firstChild);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            alertDiv.style.opacity = '0';
            setTimeout(() => alertDiv.remove(), 300);
        }, 5000);
    }

    document.getElementById('queryInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.ctrlKey) {
            startResearch();
        }
    });
</script>

</body>
